title: Epicraftia
body:
# EPICRAFTIA

I have always loved modded Minecraft, but have found that good-quality modpacks are very hard to come by. So I decided to make this, a personal mix of my favourite mods, configured to my liking. The reason I am posting this on Modrinth is, well, I think some people may find it interesting. Here, I will list some main points:

- No nasty durability!
- Amazing terrain generation!
- Reasonably vanilla-friendly!

So, if you decide to check this out, have fun! Make sure to leave suggestions too.
